filter_wrapped_in_function.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count_1  FROM donations  WHERE date_trunc(%(date_trunc_1)s::VARCHAR, donations.created_at) = %(date_trunc_2)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE

filter_range.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count_1  FROM donations  WHERE donations.created_at >= %(created_at_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND donations.created_at < %(created_at_2)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
